newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Zeitler-Germany will hit M3 target in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Zeitler-Germany will hit M3 target in 1997.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Franz-Christoph Zeitler said on Tuesday that Germany was on track to bring M3 money supply growth within the central bank's target band of 3.5 to 6.5 percent by the end of 1997.
"I consider it certainly realistic and probable that M3 will approach the target zone in this year," Zeitler told a news conference in Munich.
Latest figures for money supply, released on Monday, showed M3 growth had slowed to 8.3 percent in March from 9.1 percent in February -- still well outside the target range.
